description: The insured vehicle, a Hyundai Elantra, was stopped at a red light at the intersection of Av. Lope de Vega and Calle Rafael Augusto Sánchez when it was struck from behind by a 2017 Toyota Camry. The impact caused significant damage to the rear bumper, trunk lid, and rear passenger side. The insured experienced minor whiplash but declined further medical attention. The National Police filed a report. The vehicle was towed to Taller Express. Damages include: Rear bumper assembly (complete replacement required – cracked and detached), Trunk lid (heavily dented, alignment issue – replacement required), Rear right fender (minor dent, paint abraded – repair and repaint), Rear panel (minor crumpling, alignment required – structural repair), Exhaust system (displaced and bent – replacement), Rear left taillight (cracked lens – replacement).
